title_en: Multiply ecological learning centres in former mining areas
title_zh: 在前矿区推广生态学习中心
description: Design Harvests 3.0 proposes helping communities in ex-mining areas, including along Belt and Road geographies, set up ecological learning centres like Yunhe Forest School.

matches.conditions: Long-term local relationships and committed local leadership.
matches.rationale: Yunhe already operates in an ex-mining area and has eleven years of experience to share.

matches.conditions: Site access and a partner able to run a long-term programme.
matches.rationale: Frames post-industrial land as fertile ground for renewal, which suits ex-mining sites.

matches.conditions: Government support and a cohort that returns findings to local publics.
matches.rationale: A cohort of fellows can generate project briefs for several sites at once.

provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 29 May 2026

title_en: Yunhe Forest School seeks volunteers to share its work internationally
title_zh: 云和森林学校寻求志愿者向国际传播其工作
description: Yunhe Forest School would welcome volunteers to help get its message out internationally.
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 29 May 2026

title_en: Chedun Town seeks a rural innovation belt along its riverside
title_zh: 车墩镇寻求建设滨河乡村创新休闲带
description: The local government wants speedy implementation of the Chedun Riverside Rural Innovation Leisure Belt. Design Harvests 3.0 proposes a hub and a semi-nomadic festival, and needs practices that combine visitor experiences with real rural livelihoods.

matches.origin: Shanghai BioFarm and regenerative farm stays
matches.conditions: Visitor spending must reach the farmer and the farm.
matches.rationale: The Ten Ideas note proposes combining the wellness tourism boom with agritourism so that the farmer and her farm benefit. BioFarm is a local Shanghai partner.

matches.conditions: Needs a convenor trusted by both urban and rural groups, and a recurring gathering.
matches.rationale: Ten years of exchange across 65 counties shows how meals and stories build lasting urban-rural relationships.
Shared workshops in disused buildings could give the belt year-round activity beyond leisure.

provenance: John Thackara, Design Harvests 3.0 Ten Ideas note, 4 April 2026

title_en: Design training for urban-rural project workers
title_zh: 面向城乡项目工作者的设计培训
description: Participants in the Chedun Town Workshop asked for design training for people who work on urban-rural projects.

matches.origin: Italy and partners in five European countries
matches.conditions: A host organisation in each village and a vocational accreditation route.
matches.rationale: An Erasmus+ project on post-tourism, place-based rural development, with strong interest in the Design Harvests legacy.

matches.conditions: Course content adapted to Chinese rural policy and finance.
matches.rationale: A 12-week format already trains people to plan finance and community for rural projects.

provenance: John Thackara, Design Harvests 3.0 Ten Ideas note, 4 April 2026

title_en: Add food resilience to Shanghai wetland restoration
title_zh: 为上海湿地修复加入食物韧性维度
description: Wetland projects in Shanghai take a pioneering social-ecological approach. The proposal is to expand that work through a focus on food resilience and the social and cultural dimension of restoration.

matches.conditions: Local knowledge of edible water plants and their safe harvest.
matches.rationale: The report shows how wetland foods can link food systems, watershed recovery and a new rural economy.

provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 10 November 2025
